evidence_quotes: bestemmingsplan "Beekherstel de Run Stevert - Landgoed de Vloete" vastgesteld.
wanneer wordt begonnen met de werkzaamheden in het kader van het projectplan Waterwet.
rationale: The Dutch Council of State (RvS) preliminary-relief decision concerns a request to suspend the municipal zoning plan ("bestemmingsplan") "Beekherstel de Run Stevert - Landgoed de Vloete", which combines stream restoration ("beekherstel") and nature development with an estate development, and in which the applicant specifically cites irreversible consequences from the commencement of works under the associated Water Act project plan ("projectplan Waterwet"). Although the applicant also objects to three houses and a watchtower on the estate, the contested spatial plan and urgent-relief ground substantively integrate stream restoration and Waterwet project execution, placing the dispute in spatial_planning_water (WATER).
